Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune

Dealers, work - Monet informs the Bernheim brothers that he had suggested some frames to Paul Leprieur, curator at the Louvre, for the works from the Camondo bequest, which included 14 paintings by Monet.

Events.Title: Letter 125
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny)

Life - Monet reproaches the recipient for not calling on him during a visit to Giverny and asks to arrange a meeting to resolve matters promptly.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune (208)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune

Life - Monet anxiously asks friends to keep him informed about Sacha’s condition, expressing affection and concern while not wishing to burden Lysès.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Paul Fidelin (108)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Paul Fidelin

Garden - letter sent to to his gardener with instructions on what he wants to plant.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Josse Bernheim-Jeune (210)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Josse Bernheim-Jeune (Paris)

Life - Monet thanks Josse Bernheim for providing daily updates on the health of Sacha Guitry, expressing deep sympathy for both Sacha and Lysès and his hope for Sacha’s recovery. He mentions plans to plant a garden at Yainville to bring them joy during convalescence.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to M. Richter (191)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: M. Richter · W. ID: 3106

Garden - Monet complains about poor soil and improper garden arrangements, urgently requests the installation of wall trellises for newly planted roses, and notes that Sacha’s health is improving.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Paul Fidelin (324)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Paul Fidelin (Yainville)

Garden - Monet informs Fidelin that a delivery of plants is arriving and that he should wait for Monet’s arrival and the planting before unpacking them.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Paul Fidelin (109)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Paul Fidelin

Garden - letter sent to to his gardener with instructions on what he wants to plant.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Paul Fidelin (110)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Paul Fidelin

Garden - letter sent to to his gardener with instructions on what he wants to plant.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Paul Fidelin (111)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Paul Fidelin

Garden - letter sent to to his gardener with instructions on what he wants to plant.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Charlotte Lysés (190)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Charlotte Lysés · W. ID: 2120

Life - Monet expresses concern for Sacha’s health, supports moving to a warmer place, and hopes better weather will help him recover.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Lucien Descaves (245)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Lucien Descaves

Life - Monet gives novelist Lucien Descaves instructions to reach Giverny, in order for him and his wife to join the artist for breakfast. Monet invited Geffroy as well.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gustave Geffroy (246)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gustave Geffroy (Paris) · W. ID: 2124

Work - Monet invites Geffroy to take breakfast with him, Lucien Descaves and his wife in Giverny. He also informs him on his progress on the grandes decorations, on which he had worked for the previous two months without stop, and notes that he would love his friend’s feedback.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Josse Bernheim-Jeune (229)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Josse Bernheim-Jeune

Dealers - Monet declines a request he feels unqualified for but offers to participate as a subscriber.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Bernheim-Jeune (78)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Bernheim-Jeune (Paris)

Life - Monet writes during World War I, and in the months after Jean’s death. Mentions a recent trip to Paris, where he spent time with Renoir.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gustave Geffroy (139)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gustave Geffroy (Paris) · W. ID: 2135

Work - Monet is troubled by being preoccupied with his pictorial art when war had just broken out.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Josse Bernheim-Jeune (247)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Josse Bernheim-Jeune

Dealers, life - Monet laments his anguish over Michel’s imminent deployment. He also declines Bernheim’s request for participation, likely in their charity sale to raise funds for the war efforts.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Paul Durand-Ruel (314)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Paul Durand-Ruel

Dealers, life - Monet asks Paul Durand-Ruel to send him what he wishes from the Grosvenor Gallery exhibition. He expresses concern about Michel’s military company and his discouragement.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Capitaine de Fouquières (303)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Capitaine de Fouquières (Rouen)

Life - Monet thanks the captain for his help to repost Michel from the infantry to the army’s motor service.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gustave Geffroy (140)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gustave Geffroy (Paris) · W. ID: 2156

Work - Monet sends good wishes to Geffroy after his accident, and informs him that he is incessantly working on his Nymphéas pannels.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Mademoiselle (343) (343)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Mademoiselle (343)

Life - Monet apologises to his correspondent for his delay in getting back to her.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune (377)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune

Dealers, life - Monet thanks a friend for their good wishes and apologizes for the delay in replying, explaining that Madame Gaston [Bernheim?] has likely already given the reason.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gustave Geffroy (325)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gustave Geffroy (Paris) · W. ID: 2179

Life - Monet will see Geffroy the following Wednesday and confirms that he has received a visit from Étienne Moreau-Nélaton, who took photographs and seemed satisfied.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gustave Geffroy (174)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gustave Geffroy (Paris) · W. ID: 2185

Artists - Monet sends a note of 50 francs through Gustave Geffroy to help young painter Louis Bouchard.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to André Barbier (179)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: André Barbier · W. ID: 2186

Work - Explaining he is overwhelmed by difficult work and poor weather, and must prioritise painting, suggesting they meet in the autumn instead.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gladys Deacon (226)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gladys Deacon · W. ID: 2643

Life - Monet confirms Gladys Deacon and Countess Murat’s visit to Giverny.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune (376)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune

Dealers, Life - Monet asks his correspondent to confirm when they plan to visit Giverny with a potential buyer so he can ensure his studio is accessible before workers arrive. He also shares personal news, expressing joy at a brief visit from Michel, who has endured difficult experiences during the war.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune (319)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune

Dealers - Monet asks for further information in order to prepare for the visit of Jacques Zoubaloff, sent by the Bernheim-Jeune brothers. He also asks for news of Sacha Guitry.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gustave Geffroy (215)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gustave Geffroy (Paris) · W. ID: 2211

Life - Monet declines an invitation due to harsh weather and difficult travel conditions, apologizes sincerely, and promises to come when the weather improves while sending his warm regards.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Isidore Montaignac (328)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Isidore Montaignac · W. ID: 2215

Work - Monet has painted nothing other than the large decorations for several years and therefore has few works to offer Montaignac, but he will be delighted to receive him in Giverny and will show him what he has left.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gustave Geffroy (385)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gustave Geffroy (Paris) · W. ID: 2217

Life - Monet writes to Geffroy asking to confirm when the next Goncourt luncheon would be.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to André Barbier (122)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: André Barbier · W. ID: 2224

Life - Monet apologizes for his delayed reply, explaining that his intense focus on work and frequent trips to Paris have kept him from writing, thanks Barbier for the photographs, and invites him to visit Giverny with Geffroy when the weather improves.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Sacha Guitry (188)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Sacha Guitry · W. ID: 2225

Life - Monet regrets being unable to attend Guitry’s premiere and returns the tickets, sends affectionate regards, and expresses concern about the outcome of Guitry’s military medical review.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gustave Geffroy (288)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gustave Geffroy (Paris) · W. ID: 2226

Dealers (charity auction) - Monet says he is willing to help the blind either with money or a small work, but asks for details about the loan society and the sale process to ensure it will not disadvantage donors, and requests further information before committing.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gustave Geffroy (115)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gustave Geffroy (Paris) · W. ID: 2230

Work - Monet recounts Clementel and Damiler's visit on 30 April, where they discussed the commission to paint the bombed Reims cathedral.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Sacha Guitry (13)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Sacha Guitry · W. ID: 2233

Work - Monet wants to take advantage of the good weather to work, which will forbid him from attenting Guitry's premiere of "Un soir quand on est seul".

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Georges Clemenceau (76)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Georges Clemenceau

Work - Monet and Clemenceau plan to visit the bombed Reims cathedral, and Monet wishes to make a quick visit to his son but wants to be back at work on Monday.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune (344)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune

Life - Monet thanks one of the Bernheim-Jeune brothers for surprising him with a gift of a ‘lovely’ lighter, and thanks them for visiting Giverny.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Bernheim-Jeune (79)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Bernheim-Jeune (Paris)

Work - Monet apologizes for breaking his promise to visit, explaining that poor weather has severely disrupted his work and that he must continue painting despite exhaustion, while sending warm regards.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune (393)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune

Life, Dealers - Busy with work, Monet tries to plan lunch arrangements with one of the Bernheim brothers.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to André Barbier (34)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: André Barbier · W. ID: 2240

Work - Monet says he is exhausted from painting, he is going to rest by the sea, and postpones Barbier's visit until later.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gustave Geffroy (329)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gustave Geffroy · W. ID: 2241

Misc - Monet, tired from work, is going to Normandy to see the sea and is postponing an invitation from Barbier and Geffroy, while inquiring about the sale of a painting for the benefit of the blind, which he does not wish to see appear at a public auction at a low price.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Étienne Clémentel (289)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Étienne Clémentel

Life - Monet writes regarding his fuel supply for his studio and potential delays to his “great project”.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Bernheim-Jeune (80)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Bernheim-Jeune (Paris)

Dealers - Monet thanks Bernheim-Jeune for some reels (bobines) they sent for his son Michel, and tries to make plans to meet. The artist is expecting word from Bernheim-Jeune on when some pastels he discussed in letter no. 2253 (Vol. IV, 26 Nov 1917, p. 398) will be ready.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Frédéric Luce (290)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Frédéric Luce

Life - Responding to well-wishes for the New Year.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Mme. Barillon (212)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Mme. Barillon (Paris) · W. ID: 2259

Work - Monet urgently requests a dozen high-quality flat brushes and the dimensions of two reserved canvases from his art supplier, Madame Barillon, enclosing a hand-drawn sketch of a brush head to specify his needs.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune (330)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune

Dealers, life -Monet explains that he goes to Paris as little as possible, as it saddens and frightens him, but he reiterates his friendship and his wish to see the Bernheim-Jeune family soon.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune (378)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune

Dealers, life - Monet confirms the Bernheim brothers' planned visit to Giverny and suggests practical travel arrangements. If they cannot come by car, he offers to have them collected by automobile from the station at Mantes using his travel permit.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Georges Bernheim, Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune (326)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Georges Bernheim, Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune

Dealers, work - Monet delivers two paintings, but not "l'allée du jardin", which he has destroyed. He hopes to do better.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gustave Geffroy (351)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gustave Geffroy (Paris)

Life - Monet writes to express concern for Geffroy during the war, shares news of his family, and conveys his admiration and worry for Clemenceau.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune (322)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune

Dealers - Monet does not intend to go to Paris for the moment but will always be ready to receive the Bernheim brothers in Giverny. He asks them for the payment of two canvases and for the sending of the cigarettes they had promised him.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Bernheim-Jeune (81)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Bernheim-Jeune (Paris)

Dealers - Monet thanks B-J for the cigarettes they sent and gives payment instructions for two paintings he had sent them. This is related to letter no. 2266 (Vol. IV, 21 March 1918, p. 399) where he plans to send canvases to Paris, and asks B-J for cigarettes.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Julie (?) Manet Rouart (58)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Julie (?) Manet Rouart

Collectors - Monet advises on safeguarding the recipient’s collection during the War.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Friend (327) (327)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Friend (327)

Life - Monet thanks a friend who is sending cider for Félix Breuil, the gardener, and gives instructions regarding the shipment.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Henri Bernard (291)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Henri Bernard · W. ID: 2286

Life - A purchase of cigarettes and tobacco, on the day of the First World War Armistice.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Emile Thiebaut (292)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Emile Thiebaut

An order of vegetable seeds for Monet’s garden, including carrots, radishes, turnips, three varieties of peas, potatoes, and beans. The items are written in another hand, as well as the prices in purple ink. Monet signed the order.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Bernheim-Jeune (82)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Bernheim-Jeune (Paris)

Health - Monet cannot travel to Paris due to poor health but invites the Bernheim family to Giverny.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Étienne Clémentel (300)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Étienne Clémentel

Life - Monet thanks Clémentel for helping him get coal while general provisions were on a shortage.

Events.Title: Letter 20
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet

Miscellaneous - Monet is overwhelmed by a delivery of jars of jam.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune (379)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gaston Bernheim-Jeune (Bernheim de Villers), Josse Bernheim-Jeune

Dealers - Monet acknowledges receiving 23,672 francs for the final balance of a recent sale of paintings and thanks his correspondent for handling the transaction. Based on our other correspondence, the recipient is likely one of the Bernheim brothers, who often sent provisions to Monet during the war years and after.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Jeannie Gobillard Valéry (59)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Jeannie Gobillard Valéry

Artists - Monet shares the pain caused by Renoir’s death.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Friend (394) (394)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Friend (394)

Artists, Work - Monet politely declines a request, explaining that although he has already given generously to artists, he must now preserve his remaining works for his heirs.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Étienne Clémentel (301)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Étienne Clémentel

Life - Monet congratulates the Clémentels for their son’s marriage.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Friend (331) (331)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Friend (331)

Work - Monet thanks his correspondent but explains that he cannot fulfill the request, as his decorations are unfinished and cannot yet be shown in an exhibition.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Doctor (345) (345)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Doctor (345)

Work - Monet politely refuses a visitor whilst working on his monumental Water Lilies paintings, noting that “the slightest disturbance is always detrimental to my work”.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Arsène Alexandre (304)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Arsène Alexandre

Monet writes to Arsène Alexandre overwhelmed by the constant demands surrounding the donation of the Nymphéas and the planned monograph. He confides that he feels utterly discouraged and disillusioned, even regretting the idea of the donation and the book.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Arsène Alexandre (153)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Arsène Alexandre

Work- Monet clarifies a misunderstanding about his planned donation to the state and a publication project, explaining that a moment of discouragement led to confusion, and asks for a few days’ respite to focus on finishing his paintings before discussing matters further.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Georges Lecomte (154)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Georges Lecomte · W. ID: 2377

Artists - A short note thanking Lecomte for an article he wrote about Monet in La Renaissance.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gustave Geffroy (74)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Gustave Geffroy · W. ID: 2408

Health - Monet apologizes for his delayed reply due to poor health and worsening eyesight, reaffirms his friendship, and expresses willingness to assist with biographical information despite his difficulty reading.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gustave Geffroy (293)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gustave Geffroy (Paris) · W. ID: 2421

Artists, life - Monet provides information about Caillebotte’s surviving family and suggests contacts for further details, then warmly mentions his pleasure at returning to Giverny after a joyful day in Paris, especially visiting the Louvre.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Director of the Societe des Droits d'Auteur des Artistes (380)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Director of the Societe des Droits d'Auteur des Artistes

Work, Dealers - Monet acknowledges receipt of two cheques for royalties relating to one of his paintings and confirms the sale of Pont sur la Tamise by Georges Petit.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gustave Geffroy (9)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Gustave Geffroy · W. ID: 2431

Life - Monet provides Geffroy with information for his biography.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Lucien Moline (127)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Lucien Moline

Work - Monet received an enquiry from Mme Donop de Monchy asking if he painted La gare d'Angenteuil (W.242). Monet is unsure, as it would have been a long time ago.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Élie Faure (87)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Élie Faure · W. ID: 3059

Misc. - Monet sends 1000 fr in response to an appeal by Faure to a number of artists, seeking their assistance in raising funds for Francisco Iturrino.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Gustave Geffroy (248)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Gustave Geffroy (Paris) · W. ID: 2461

Work - Monet agrees to help with the reproductions for Geffroy's book, despite doubting their quality, asks which paintings are concerned, and notes that studio changes and negotiations over his Decorations are disrupting his work.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Paul Signac (112)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Paul Signac

Health - Monet declines Signac’s petition to join him and other comrades in a demonstration due to his old age.

Events.Title: Letter 155
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny)

Work - Monet writes to an unidentified public servant about the arrangements for the formal donation of the Water Lilies series to the French state.

Events.Title: Letter 64
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet

Health - Monet apologises for the delay in thanking his correspondent for their volume and remarks on his declining eyesight.

Events.Title: Letter 113
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet

Miscellaneous - note reading “Les seuls autographes intéressants sont ceux que l'on découvre et non ceux que l'on demande".

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Ambroise Vollard (96)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Ambroise Vollard

Artists - Monet thanks Vollard for sending him his book on Renoir.

Events.Title: Letter 249
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny)

Life - Short note on a business card in which Monet refers to himself as “almost blind,” likely written shortly before his cataract surgery.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Georges Jeanniot (18)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Georges Jeanniot

Health - Monet thanks Jeanniot for writing to him after his cataract operation.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Ambroise Vollard (97)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Ambroise Vollard

Health - Monet declines an offer (probably of a literary capacity) made by Vollard due to his bad eyesight.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Edmond de Rothschild (103)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Edmond de Rothschild

Garden - Monet compliments Rothschild’s Japanese garden after visiting his property in Boulogne with Georges Clemenceau.

Events.Title: Letter 294
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny)

Monet’s mailing card, signed and dated on the verso

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Dr. Charles Coutela (98)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Dr. Charles Coutela

Health - Monet writes a note to Charles Coutela saying that he is doing well. This was a writing exercise sent to George Clemenceau with WL. 2530 (not in AH collection).

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Georges Clemenceau (254)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Georges Clemenceau · W. ID: 2533

Monet explains that although his reading has improved, his color vision remains limited (mostly yellow and blue), preventing him from traveling, but he remains patient and hopeful.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Georges Clemenceau (60)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Georges Clemenceau · W. ID: 2536

Health - Monet writes about gardening and the condition of his eyesight (the text barely legible as a result of Monet’s eye trouble).

Events.Title: Claude Monet to John Singer Sargent (346)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: John Singer Sargent

Artists - Monet writes to Sargent via Lily Butler, who is travelling to London and will convey his regards while requesting information on a commission; he also expresses regret at not having heard from him and reaffirms his friendship.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to André Barbier (382)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: André Barbier · W. ID: 2566

Health- Writing shortly after cataract surgery and awaiting special glasses, Monet looks forward to Barbier’s visit and the arrival of ophthalmologist Jacques Mawas to help restore his vision.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to André Barbier (263)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: André Barbier · W. ID: 2570

Health, work - At a time when his blindness was increasing, Monet writes about continuing to work on his Nymphéas series.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to André Barbier (381)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: André Barbier · W. ID: 2572

Health - Monet reports mixed results with new glasses, finding those from optician Unger unsatisfactory, while praising the tinted lenses provided by Dr. Mawas. Despite ongoing vision difficulties and poor weather, he notes that he continues to work and asks Barbier to pass along his thanks to Mawas.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Félix Fénéon (193)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Félix Fénéon

Work - Monet identifies the dates and origins of several of his early works.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to André Barbier (156)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: André Barbier · W. ID: 2581

Misc - Monet confirms Sunday lunch, mentions possibly needing new lenses, asks his friend to bring brushes, and notes that paint supplies are going well with Guichardaz.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to René Delange (69)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: René Delange

Life - Monet apologizes for his delayed invitation and poor reception during a previous visit, explaining he has been overwhelmed and discouraged, and promises to reschedule soon.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Thadée Natanson (29)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: Thadée Natanson

Life - Monet thanks Natanson for reaching out to him at a time of despair and self-doubt.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to André Barbier (227)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: André Barbier (Paris) · W. ID: 2599

Life - Monet briefly informs his friend that he has left the latest Zeiss glasses at Meyrowitz for him to collect, and explains that a recent bereavement prevents him from receiving visitors.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to André Barbier (104)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet · To: André Barbier · W. ID: 2600

Health, work - Monet apologizes for his delayed reply, explains that his eyesight has only slightly improved despite treatment, expresses his despair at believing he can no longer paint, and thanks his friend warmly for his continued support.

Events.Title: Letter 19
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet

Life - Monet writes in support of the appointment of Louis Vauxcelles as curator of the Musée du Luxembourg.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to André Barbier (259)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: André Barbier · W. ID: 2609

Work - Monet invites his friend to Giverny, shares his joy at his greatly improved eyesight and renewed enthusiasm for work, but warns that he will be unable to host him for lunch.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to Charlotte Lysés (12)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: Charlotte Lysés

Work - Monet writes to a sick friend promising to visit on a bad weather day, when he cannot paint outside. He is glad his eyesight has improved and can resume painting.

Events.Title: Claude Monet to André Barbier (341)
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny) · To: André Barbier · W. ID: 2614

Work - Monet tells Barbier he is fully absorbed in work and cannot host him at Giverny, reminds him of his promise to give him a painting in exchange for one received, and clarifies the high prices at which he has recently sold sketches and canvases to friends.

Events.Title: Letter 295
Events.Body:
From: Claude Monet (Giverny)

Work - Monet declines permission for reproductions of A Giverny chez Claude Monet and notes that he has not received the copyright royalties from the sale of his painting Westminster, effet de brouillard at a recent Drouot auction.
